Every one of 27189 directed face-incidences is traversed in an acyclic topological sort, establishing the integral wedge type independent of mod-2 homology. For all 27 translations the signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz sums match weights (46,4,-2,1); independent quotient-orbit vectors (9,18,6), (9,9,3) and empty explain all nonidentity cases. Finite group orthogonality, calculated integrally, yields Fourier multiplicities (2,2,2,1) for weight 0,1,2,3. Dimension, boundary ranks, group-invariants and finite-quotient rational statement follow with explicit hypotheses. Verified by embedded independent-from-data script; no unsupported infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The naturally transitive 27-element translation action on the first fully nonbinary ternary triple Hamming Rips complex defines a structural representation invariant beyond the known 46-sphere rank. The distinction between 19 dual weights of multiplicity two and eight full-support weights of multiplicity one is not a normalization or automatic rank consequence: it follows from the three materially different fixed-orbit clique complexes, and determines the exact rational homology of a canonical finite quotient. Exact finite symmetry classification is a meaningful reusable benchmark without requiring any general-family claim.
